results.rationale: Consistency: existing squirrels, trees, umbrellas, mushrooms and the grid retain their locations and appearance. Instruction: all four blanks receive pictures, but only row 2 column 2 has the correct umbrella; row 1 duplicates umbrellas, row 3 adds mushrooms instead of a squirrel, and row 4 adds mushrooms instead of a tree. Knowledge: repeated symbols violate row/column Sudoku constraints; instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality: the cartoon symbols and grid are clean, readable and free of visual corruption.

Consistency: the pendant's round setting and chain are materially deformed, beyond the allowed repositioning, lighting and background treatment. Instruction: a centered pendant, gray-blue background and bottom text are present, but the text reads 'yed' instead of 'yet', the background lacks convincing velvet, and the pendant is not convincingly suspended. Quality: both chain ends float disconnected from the bail, and the gemstone/setting smear into an amorphous doubled form; the text also contains a malformed word.
